data.name: Hashimah
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hashimah is derived from the name Hashim, which means 'the one who follows the path of Hashim'. Hashim was a respected ancestor of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and an important figure in the early Islamic community. Hashimah is thus a name that symbolizes loyalty, devotion, and following the righteous path.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep Islamic roots and symbolic of following the righteous path.
data.numerology_meaning: In Islamic numerology, the life path number 6 represents harmony, balance, and love.
